definitions.explanation: A formal or technical term for the potato. Common in agricultural, scientific, and food-labeling contexts rather than everyday speech.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}に{馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}でんぷんが{含|ふく}まれている。
{北海道|ほっかいどう}は{馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}の{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is famous as a potato-producing region.

examples.japanese: {農家|のうか}は{今年|ことし}も{良質|りょうしつ}な{馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}を{収穫|しゅうかく}することができた。
examples.english: The farmers were able to harvest good-quality potatoes again this year.

notes:
Formal/technical synonym of じゃがいも. Most often seen on food labels (e.g., {馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}でんぷん, potato starch), in agricultural statistics, and in academic writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}でんぷん: potato starch
- {馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}の{栽培|さいばい}: potato cultivation
- {馬鈴薯|ばれいしょ}{粉|こ}: potato flour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- じゃがいも: potato — the everyday word used in conversation, recipes, and most writing
- ポテト: potato — loanword, common in product names (フライドポテト, ポテトサラダ)
